description: On the table there’s an orange bowl near the back, a small yellow duck and two dark round items beside it, and a yellow bread-shaped piece in the foreground with a small brown egg-shaped item to the right. The left hand stays resting on the table, while the right hand moves in from the right, grasps the brown egg-shaped item as a right-hand object, lifts it up and arcs it leftward over the orange bowl, then lowers it into the bowl and releases it before withdrawing.
